title: Dispatch start marker (dispatch-start)
description: Appended by every dispatched project-defined agent (except pipeline-coordinator and the terminal change-grader) as its first tool call. The start half of the dispatch-event contract: a dispatch-start for (req_id, agent) with no subsequent substantive record from the same agent is the deterministic truncation signal. The substantive-record enum and the exemptions live in the handoff-routing skill § Dispatch Truncation Detection; their rationale in that skill's route-spec.md. The contract is prompt-side discipline; there is no runtime enforcement.

author.description: The dispatched agent's name: a core specialist, the review-planner (dispatched on a gray review-plan), or a roster reviewer (the roster is defined in review-workflow § Review Phase). pipeline-coordinator and change-grader are intentionally omitted (exempt from the contract per the description above). The roster is enforced by the doctor, not by this schema; the pattern only shape-checks the name (same convention as review-feedback.author).

responding_to.description: 1-indexed line numbers in .scratch/handoff.jsonl pointing to the record(s) this dispatch is responding to — the inbound anchor named in the agent's definition. Empty array is invalid. For the very first dispatch in a fresh feature context where no prior record exists, set to [0] as a sentinel meaning 'fresh feature, no inbound record.'
